messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: dartR version 2.0.4
parts:
Dear all,

This is just to let you know that the latest version of dartR (v 2.0.4) is now on CRAN and can be installed by typing in the R console:

> install.packages("dartR")

Below are described the improvements and bug fixes in this version.

Cheers,

Luis

Improvements:

- gl.plot.structure: CLUMPP and Clumpak approaches can be run without installing these programs. Improved plot and added options to customise it.

- gl.run.structure: Installation of StrataG is not necessary to run the function.

- gl.filter.allna: Add an option to recalculate loc.metrics.

- gl.filter.hwe and gl.report.hwe: Add the option to remove loci only if they are concurrently significant in more than N populations.

- gl.filter.maf: Add option to filter on minor allele frequency (MAC)

- gl.report.diversity: add the option to print or not the plot. 

- gl2genepop: Add the option to choose from a 2 digits format or a 3 digits format as output. Populations can now be ordered using a vector.

- gl.dist.pop and gl.dist.ind: Add labels to the distance matrix.

- gl.diagnostics.hwe: Add option to compute or not standard errors. 

- gl.read.dart: add the option to remove loci with all missing data. 

- gl2vcf: Add alleles to @loc.all. The order of reference and alternative alleles is the same as the genlight object. 

- various functions: Add a flag to check whether loci with all missing data have been filtered.


Bugs fixes:

- gl.filter.allna: Fix bug when more loci were filtered out with the option by.pop.

- gl.install.vanilla.dartR: Fix the bug that prevented installing the "dev" version. 

- gl.report.sexlinked and gl.filter.sexlinked: Display now the same information. 

- gl2plink: Fix bug in the name of chromosomes.
